name: Forgot User Name
description: Sent when a user selects Forgot User Name on the Sign In page and then supplies an email address that is valid for their account.
subject: Your user name for ${PRODUCT_NAME}
body:
Your user name

Dear ${user.name},

You requested your ${PRODUCT_NAME} user name. The details are below.

User name: ${user.uid}

Please sign in at: ${identityNowUrl}

If you did not request this information, please contact your administrator immediately.

Thank you,
The ${PRODUCT_NAME} Team
